meta.name: Menya Icyongereza vocabulary pilot
meta.selection: Stratified random sample covering all 57 reference groups: two words per word group, twelve extra words chosen by seed, and one sentence pair per sentence group. Entry order was randomized with the same seed.
meta.verification: Every word was checked against a live Glosbe English-Kinyarwanda page; reverse Glosbe pages were used where the English page did not list the form. Sentence pairs come from the supplied reference table and need native review because exact everyday sentence pairs are not available in the online dictionaries checked.

status_values.verified: The Kinyarwanda form appears on the cited live Glosbe page.
status_values.native_review_required: Reference-table sentence pair; exact pair not found online; needs native speaker confirmation.

notes: Word mode remains 7 pairs per video; sentence mode is 4 pairs (8 text lines) per video.
All 57 reference groups are represented once.
Do not expand to the full 1,098 entries until the user reviews this pilot.

groups.title: Everyday Foods
groups.notes: Pilot uses rice and milk; other foods are queued for the full expansion.

groups.title: Home Items
groups.notes: Door uses urugi (verified); the reference also lists umuryango (gate/door).

groups.title: Talking in Class
groups.notes: Good morning is verified online; the other pair needs native review.

groups.title: Character Words (UMUNTU)
groups.notes: Pilot uses honest and patient, verified through reverse Glosbe entries.

groups.title: Work Roles
groups.notes: Doctor and nurse; farmer is also verified but is outside this 100-entry sample.

groups.title: Repair Verbs
groups.notes: Pilot uses to repair (gusana); the reference also lists to fix.

groups.title: Weather Words
groups.notes: Pilot uses verified weather nouns (sun, rain, wind); sunny/rainy adjective forms are queued for review.

groups.title: Office People
groups.notes: Accountant uses umucungamari (verified); the reference also lists umubaruramari.

groups.title: Family Relations
groups.notes: Pilot uses daughter, father and sister; grandparent/uncle forms are queued for native review.

groups.title: Sound Adjectives (IJWI)
groups.notes: Pilot uses verified sound words (silent, noise); adjective forms are queued for review.

groups.title: Clothing Items
groups.notes: Trousers uses ipantaro (verified spelling); the reference spelling was ipantalo.

groups.title: Taste Adjectives
groups.notes: Sour is listed as sharira (verified root); the adjective gisharira needs native confirmation.
